fields.options: Accounts the Trust module posts to, per company. A donation cannot be receipted for a company until its row exists here - the accounts are never guessed from account codes or names.

fields.label: Require Donor PAN Above
fields.description: Form 10BD cannot be filed for a donor without an identification number. Donations at or above this value are refused when the donor has no PAN.

fields.label: Block Cash Donation Above
fields.description: Section 269ST caps a single cash receipt at Rs 2,00,000. Set to 0 to disable the check.

fields.label: Enforce FCRA Segregation on Submit
fields.description: Validates the GL entries every voucher produces. Turning this off is logged; it exists only for data migration.

fields.label: Section 115BBC Threshold
fields.description: Anonymous donations are taxable above the higher of this amount and 5% of total donations.
